lines.text: After three quiet years, Jehoshaphat visits Ahab, who asks him to fight Aram for Ramoth-gilead, and Jehoshaphat agrees.
Jehoshaphat asks Ahab to inquire of the LORD first, so Ahab assembles about four hundred prophets, who all say go up.
Ahab hates Micaiah son of Imlah, and Zedekiah makes iron horns to gore the Philistines at the gate of Samaria.
Micaiah first tells Ahab to go up and triumph, then says he saw Israel scattered like sheep without a home.

wrong_details.true: without a shepherd (the people have no master)

lines.text: Ahab orders Micaiah returned to Amon and Joash and put in prison on bread and water until he returns safely.
